# Inventory intake

The naming worker runs on Linux and receives Windows paths from the warehouse export station.

turns.prompt: Windows inventory naming: First open this page before reading the local files: https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v22.x/api/path.html . Read config/inventory_path.json, src/inventory_name.cjs, docs/runtime.md, and data/name-register.json. On the Linux worker, which manifest identifier in the name register has a filename that exactly matches the script's printed text (excluding its final newline)? Compare the filenames case-sensitively. Return only the manifest identifier. Do not modify files.

provenance.notes: 显式 win32.basename 在 Linux 上取文件名；.csv 不匹配 .CSV，输出 cedar.inventory.CSV，对应本地登记项 manifest-42；以登记项标识判分，避免判分器忽略大小写而接受错误文件名或完整路径。
